description: This file contains unit tests for functions related to group members management, specifically testing the normalization of phone numbers, deduplication of participants, and formatting of group members list within a WhatsApp auto-reply extension.

methods.name: noteGroupMember
methods.description: Adds a group member to the collection after normalizing the phone number, ignores incomplete values.

methods.name: formatGroupMembers
methods.description: Formats group members list, deduplicates participants, and includes roster members with names; falls back to a default sender if no members are available.

ctags.name: groupMemberNames
ctags.pattern: /^    const groupMemberNames = new Map<string, Map<string, string>>();$/
